title: A World of Alternate Paths
text: “Here we go!”
I’ll give the signal for Ceremonial Magic from the rear. Then, from behind, various Ceremonial Magic—tornadoes, Meteorites, and spells of Judgment—are unleashed toward the Dragon King.
“Al-Liberation Double Firestorm X!”

Chanting the spell with both hands, I unleashed it at the Dragon King. Two massive fiery tornadoes swirled around the Dragon King, scorching it as it tried to escape by transforming into rain clouds and fog.

Eventually, the Dragon King rose into the air, spinning in a corkscrew motion while being tossed about by the two fiery tornadoes. Even after putting this much power into it, the fact that it’s still alive shows just how tough it is.
“Brionac X! Gungnir X! Meteor Thrust X! Aiming Lancer X!”

As the finishing blow, I unleashed my Skills. Next… I’ll use a skill that takes a long time to cast… one that’s completely impractical. According to my Father, it’s overkill. But I’ll show them just how formidable a Hero I am!
“Lunatic Judgment X!”
Putting all my strength into the spear, I leap high into the air. Then, as I lock onto my target, the spear freezes solid in midair.

Keeping my weight on the spear, I stare at the Dragon King, which is frozen in place as it’s bombarded by a barrage of various Magic, Skills, and Ceremonial Magic. A massive magical orb forms at the tip of my spear. The time it takes for that orb to be drawn into the spear—the charge time—is endless.

It takes far longer than it does for a Brionac. Unlike a Brionac, where the charge time can be shortened the more power you pour into it, this requires a charge time that goes beyond comparison. I concentrate my SP, Magical Power, and EP to the point where I can somehow manage to use it. Eventually, upon confirming that the entire spear had flashed brightly, I unleashed it at the Dragon King.
“This… is the finishing blow!”

I continued firing until I hit the Dragon King—which had been showing signs of recovery from All Cannon Fire—with “Bind Cross,” a restraining skill that immobilizes it by driving a stake into it to further restrict its movement. It was a close call. The Dragon King was locked in place with a thud by the Bind Cross… Well, since it turns into water, it was tough to pin down, but I managed to stop it. Lunatic Judgment hit the Dragon King, and after a single implosion at its center, it triggered a massive explosion. Our field of vision was completely filled with light.
“Whoa—”
“W-what kind of power is that?”
“Wow, that’s amazing!”
“Is it over now?”
“I wonder if we took it down?”

The Melromarc Army and Filolial-sama are sharing their thoughts, even as they’re still blinded by the light. I, too, shield my eyes with my hand and focus on the number in my field of vision. The number 10 is flashing. It seems we’ve managed to take down the Dragon King.

It seems we hadn’t actually defeated it in the previous battle after all. Or perhaps we defeated it within the grace period allotted for defeating the other Four Spirits. It’s probably safest to assume there’s still a grace period before we can defeat them all simultaneously.

The scattered remains of the Dragon King are falling from the sky. It doesn’t seem to be liquefying or showing any signs of regenerating. The effect of the “Prominence” spell I cast has also worn off, and the sky has returned to a clear blue.
“‘“Waaaaaaaaah!”’”
I can hear cheers from the Melromarc Army and Filolial-sama’s group.
“Don’t get carried away by victory! It’s not over yet.”

The Queen’s words make perfect sense. Judging by their reactions, the Phoenix and the Spirit Tortoise are still alive and attempting to revive the Qilin and the Dragon King. The remaining time… feels like about six minutes, I suppose? Just as I was thinking that, one minute had passed, and the number “8” flashed.
That leaves 7… the Spirit Tortoise. That’s the Panda Beastman, Kou, and Luna-chan. Was it a bit too much to ask of the Panda Beastman? I think Kou and Luna-chan are putting up a good fight.
I’ll move closer to Filolial-sama and the Melromarc Army to watch how things unfold.
“Lord Kitamura, how’s it going?”
“Only the Spirit Tortoise remains.”
The time remaining… is probably under two minutes now! This is bad. We’ll have to consider the possibility of the operation failing.
“Ah…”

Filolial-sama has spotted a blue hourglass floating in the blue sky. The hourglass, glowing blue as if on the verge of filling up, is slowly descending. Could it be… that the Dragon King is about to appear from there again?
Just as I thought that, the number “7” flickered, and the hourglass’s numbers…? With a blinding blue flash, something dome-shaped shot past us like the wind. My eyes are still stinging.
“W-what on earth was that…?”
“I think we’ve defeated all four Spirits. All the numbers on the blue hourglasses were flashing, after all.”
“So, was that just a sign that we’ve defeated it?”
That’s strange. There shouldn’t have been a light like this when we defeated the Phoenix. I suppose I should consult with my Father, but the numbers in my field of vision…?
――And so, the world was saved.
“Branching Worlds”: Activation conditions met. Is this okay? 0:59 → Yes / No
That option just popped up. What’s this all about? It says the world was saved, but I’d say the world’s actually in complete chaos.

Also… there’s not a trace of the hourglass showing the arrival time of the next wave after defeating the Spirit Tortoise and the Phoenix. Just then, my father and the others arrived through the portal.
“Motoyasu! Things must have gone well over there, right!?”
“We did it.”
“Yeah. I was keeping an eye on things too, and I came here to meet up with you just as we planned.”
Immediately after that, Yuki-chan and the others, along with the panda beastmen, arrived through the portal.
“Let’s hear from everyone about what exactly happened. The Four Spirits… were they defeated?”
Everyone present was too stunned to speak. I got the feeling that things hadn’t gone as planned.
“I think I managed to defeat the Qilin with Sakura-chan, Melty-chan, and the folks from Faubrey.”
“Sakura smacked the Qilin right in the head with a huge thud, didn’t she?”
“Sakura-chan was amazing, wasn’t she?”
“Yeah, Mel-chan fought alongside us, too.”
“As for Takt’s former comrades… they charged in without knowing the truth. Even though Takt isn’t here, they said they were going to protect the country…”
Hmm, even though they’re the enemy, I can’t help but feel a little sympathy for them. Well, since I’m the one who killed Takt and his group, maybe it’s a bit odd to feel that way.
“I defeated the Dragon King, too. Come to think of it, some weird adventurers suddenly showed up, charged in, and just vanished.”
I didn’t even have time to defend it. What on earth was that all about?
“Um… given the situation, maybe it couldn’t be helped, but Motoyasu, why did you defeat the Dragon King right after the Kirin? According to our plan, it was supposed to be last…”
“I’d completely forgotten! I suppose that’s what they call the heat of battle.”
“What are you trying to justify yourself for!? It turned out okay in the end, so fine, but next time, stick to the plan!”
“Got it! From now on, I, Motoyasu, will stick faithfully to the plan.”
Father looks utterly exasperated. It was actually quite a struggle, you know. I was on the edge of my seat because Filolial-sama was being used as bait.
“I also took down Wyndia-chan… and, though I’m not happy about it, Gaelion too!”
“I definitely felt a solid impact!”
“Yeah, they were really strong.”
“We all worked hard! Big Sis did the best job!”
“I’m the one who did the best job, you know.”
“It was Big Sis!”
Yuki-chan and her Rival have started glaring at each other. I’m siding with Yuki-chan and joining the staring contest.
“Let’s leave Motoyasu and the others alone… So, that leaves Lars-chan, Kou, and Luna-chan…”
“Kou didn’t do anything wrong! So don’t tear him apart!”
Kou answers in a way that makes it seem like he’s scared of Father. He clearly sees Father as a source of terror.

“Um… I’m not mad, so I’d like you to tell me what happened. I just want to get a handle on what went down, and since it looks like you guys took them down, I’m not mad either. Besides, nobody said anyone was at fault, right?”
“Ugh…”
“Both Luna and Kou managed to take down the heart… The attacks were way more intense than before, but we took it down properly.”
Luna-chan speaks up in Kou’s place.
“What about Lars-chan?”
“Her attacks were pretty brutal and hard to handle. We ended up causing quite a bit of damage to the Allied Forces who were covering us.”
“I see… but you managed to take her down, right?”
“I think we destroyed its head, but right when we thought it was the final blow, that breath attack came flying out. It dealt a massive blow to the Allied Forces. Also… something felt off, you know?”
“Off how?”
“There was one time when we destroyed the head and heart right on schedule, but it didn’t count as a defeat.”
“Does that mean…”
Huh? Does Father have an idea what’s going on, too?
“Motoyasu, do you remember the time you challenged the Spirit Tortoise before?”
“I remember. I couldn’t defeat it.”
“Yeah. Back then, when I thought I’d defeated it at first—right after you crushed its head, Motoyasu—it regenerated immediately.”
“Oh? Did something like that really happen?”
“Yeah. Well, I defeated it right away, so nothing came of it. I just figured my timing was off.”
It’s a matter of simultaneous destruction, isn’t it? It’s something that can happen if your timing is even slightly off. Why are you acting so surprised?
“Well, it regenerated right away, and when I finally managed to defeat it, the system registered the kill, so I guess it must have been some kind of glitch.”
“Yeah… that was tough.”

It seems the battle against the Spirit Tortoise was quite a close one. Part of it had to do with the number of people we assigned to the fight, but given the circumstances, that was the best we could do.
